memories.content: Chris has custody of Ezra Sunday through Friday this week. He started a new job as a service manager three weeks ago, out at 7 a.m., back after 6 p.m. His father had a stent placed Tuesday, so evenings are spent on calls with his mom. He has notifications for the school app turned off. Ezra mentioned 'there's a thing in my folder' on Tuesday while Chris was on a work call, but Chris hasn't followed up.

Ezra's fourth-grade class has an overnight trip to a nature camp next week. The permission slip and $85 fee are due at the school office by 3 p.m. Friday, September 18, when the cabin and bus count goes final. The form is still in Ezra's backpack as of the start time. The school app is available; Chris has notifications off, Naomi sees it as a 6 a.m. email digest. The school office is open during school hours.
